The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Utkal University recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Utkal University recruitment is Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. degree with a minimum of 55% or equivalent CGPA in Botany, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or Environmental Science.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 12000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at Utkal University, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, 751004.
